subject: Post-call: Redwood + FintechCo discovery recap
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Chris Ramos <chris.ramos@fintechco.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 15:24:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Redwood + FintechCo discovery recap

Hi Chris —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

- Key goals: reduce inference latency for real-time fraud scoring (p95 < 100ms) and cut per-call cost by ~30% on high-volume endpoints.
- Current infra: internal API on GKE, models hosted via vendor X, internal rate ~3k qps at peak.
- Success criteria for POC: reach target latency at 1k qps with competitive cost, basic integration with their API, and a short QPS/latency report.

Proposed next steps:
1) Intro call with our SE (Dev) to map integration and data access — suggested window: next week (Tue/Wed).
2) 4-week POC focusing on 1 endpoint (fraud-score-v1).
3) Provide test dataset or sample API credentials (we can hash/anonymize if needed).

If you can confirm timeframe and who would be the primary technical contact on your side, I can loop Dev in and get the kickoff scheduled. Attached are my short discovery notes from today.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0147
Redwood Inference

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (1 page, notes from 3/1 discovery call)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Align before recontacting FintechCo (no response)

Team —

Quick internal thread: I sent the discovery recap to Chris on 3/1 (below) and haven't heard back. No reply yet — wanted to align before I poke again.

Context / ask:
- FintechCo is a mid-market payments platform (deal FT-2026-1347). They care about latency and cost; procurement will want evidence (latency reports, SOC2 is already in our portal).
- My ask: decide approach for re-contact. Options I’m considering:
  a) Simple bump to Chris with a one-liner and propose 2 slot options for SE intro (low friction).
  b) Warm recontact with short tailored collateral (2-slide latency/cost summary + benchmarking numbers) and a suggested POC scope (2-week sandbox vs 4-week full POC).
  c) Wait another week and escalate to their VP (if they shared that contact) — prefer to avoid without alignment.

Please reply with:
- Dev: which approach would be quickest to assemble? Do you recommend 2-week sandbox or full 4-week POC given their stated goals?
- Monica (CS): if we do a 2-week sandbox, what does the success plan look like on our side (handoff, metrics, minimal scope)?
- Aditya: are we comfortable authorizing a small pilot credit if needed? If so, what range should I propose (e.g., $5-10k)?

Target: I’d like to re-contact them by Friday 3/5 if we choose the quick bump; if we need collateral, aim for 3/8. Thoughts?

Thanks — attaching the discovery notes and HubSpot deal link for context.

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Align before recontacting FintechCo (no response)

Sounds good — quick thoughts:
- I can put together a 2-slide latency/cost summary and a short demo script by EOD Thu. That will let us recontact with tangible numbers.
- Given their goals, I’d push for a 2-week sandbox first (narrow scope: one endpoint, sandbox dataset, our infra at 1k qps) to prove latency/cost with minimal effort. If that succeeds, roll to a 4-week integration POC.
- For the sandbox we’ll need: sample payloads (anonymized), an API key, and a contact who can verify results. I can run a basic benchmark and generate a p95/p99 and cost delta table.

If we plan to recontact Fri (3/5) with a light bump, I can have the 2-slide attached. If we wait until Mon (3/8) I can include the quick benchmark numbers from our side.

— Dev

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Align before recontacting FintechCo (no response)

Thanks — appreciate the fast turn. Plan below:

1) Move forward with option (b) — warm recontact with tailored collateral and a recommended 2-week sandbox as the low-friction first step.
2) Dev: please finalize the 2-slide latency/cost summary + quick benchmark by EOD Mon (3/8). Attach here and I'll include when I recontact.
3) Monica: draft a one-page sandbox success plan (key metrics, roles, timeline) — I'll attach as well.
4) Aditya: can you confirm pilot credit approval of up to $7,500 if they request it? If yes, I'll include in my outreach as an optional concession to accelerate POC sign-up.

I'll schedule a 20-min sync tomorrow (3/9) at 10:00 AM PST to review the collateral — invite incoming now. If we're aligned, I'll send the recontact note to Chris on 3/10 with the attachments and two proposed kickoff slots.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567/FT-2026-1347
